# Secrets & environment variables checklist

Companion to `COOLIFY_DEPLOYMENT.md`. Grouped by where each value gets configured.

## 1. Auto-generated by Coolify (Supabase service)

When you deploy the Supabase service in Coolify, it generates these — copy them
somewhere safe. `ANON_KEY` and `SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` get reused in sections 3 and 4 below.

- `JWT_SECRET`
- `ANON_KEY`
- `SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
- Postgres password
- Studio dashboard credentials

## 2. Supabase service → GoTrue (auth) env vars

| Variable | Value / source |
|---|---|
| `SITE_URL` | `https://maalihub.com` |
| `ADDITIONAL_REDIRECT_URLS` | `https://maalihub.com/auth/callback,https://www.maalihub.com/auth/callback` |
| `GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_ENABLED` | `true` |
| `GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` | Google Cloud Console → OAuth client |
| `GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_SECRET` | Google Cloud Console → OAuth client |
| `GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST` / `_PORT` / `_USER` / `_PASS` | your SMTP provider (e.g. Resend SMTP) |
| `GOTRUE_SMTP_ADMIN_EMAIL` | e.g. `no-reply@maalihub.com` |
| `GOTRUE_HOOK_SEND_EMAIL_ENABLED` / `_URI` | only if using the custom email hook function |

## 3. Edge functions container env vars

| Variable | Source |
|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `https://maalihub.com,https://www.maalihub.com` |
| `SITE_URL` | `https://maalihub.com` |
| `CRON_SECRET` | `openssl rand -hex 32` |
| `INTERNAL_EMAIL_SECRET` | `openssl rand -hex 32` |
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | Resend dashboard |
| `FROM_EMAIL` | e.g. `MAALI <no-reply@maalihub.com>` |
| `SUPPORT_EMAIL` / `CONTACT_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL` | your team inbox |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Stripe dashboard, **live** `sk_live_...` |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Stripe → Webhooks, after registering the endpoint (§8 in `COOLIFY_DEPLOYMENT.md`) |
| `STRIPE_MEMBER_PRICE_ID` | Stripe live-mode product/price |
| `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY` | Paystack dashboard, live `sk_live_...` |
| `PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY` | Paystack dashboard, live `pk_live_...` |
| `GOOGLE_CLOUD_TRANSLATE_API_KEY` | GCP → Cloud Translation API |
| `ABSTRACT_API_KEY` | Abstract API (email validation on signup) |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` | Cloudflare Turnstile site (server secret) |
| `EMAIL_LOGO_URL` | optional |

## 4. Frontend build variables (Coolify app — must be marked **Build Variable**)

| Variable | Source |
|---|---|
| `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` | `https://api.maalihub.com` |
| `VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | from section 1 |
| `VITE_SITE_URL` | `https://maalihub.com` |
| `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | Stripe, `pk_live_...` |
| `VITE_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY` | Paystack, `pk_live_...` |
| `VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` | Cloudflare Turnstile — **same site** as `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` above |
| `VITE_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY` / `_HOST` | optional (analytics) |
| `VITE_SENTRY_DSN` | optional (error tracking) |

⚠️ `VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` and `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` must come from the **same**
Turnstile site, and both are required in production — Edge Functions reject
signup/login/contact/application submissions outright if `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is
unset against a real (non-local) Supabase URL.

## 5. Local deploy script config (not a server secret)

`scripts/.deploy.env` (gitignored, copy from `scripts/.deploy.env.example`) — used
only when running `scripts/deploy-selfhosted.sh` from your own machine to push
migrations/functions to the VPS. Not deployed anywhere; stays on your laptop.

| Variable | Value / source |
|---|---|
| `DB_URL` | Postgres URL via SSH tunnel, e.g. `postgresql://postgres:<pw>@127.0.0.1:5433/postgres` — password is Coolify → Supabase service → Environment Variables → `SERVICE_PASSWORD_POSTGRES` |
| `VPS_HOST` | VPS IP or `vps.maalihub.com` |
| `VPS_USER` | SSH user for deploys |
| `FUNCTIONS_VOLUME` | Absolute path to the edge-runtime functions volume on the VPS (Coolify → Supabase service → Storages) |
| `FUNCTIONS_CONTAINER` | docker container name of the edge-runtime service (`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'`) |
| `SSH_KEY` (optional) | override if not using default SSH config |
| `DOCKER` (optional) | set to `sudo docker` if the VPS user isn't in the `docker` group |

## Not required for launch

- `VITE_MAINTENANCE_MODE` / `_MESSAGE` / `_ESTIMATED_TIME` / `_CONTACT_EMAIL` — only
  needed to toggle a maintenance page.
- `VITE_API_URL` — defaults to `localhost:3000`, not wired to anything live in this
  app; skip it.
